title: `!if` at a declaration position
description: A resource declaration chosen before boot: the tag carries its `metadata`, each branch is one unnamed declaration.

metadata.description: The declaration's metadata; its `name` is the one name every configuration declares.

if.description: A boolean decided before boot: a `!cel` condition or a literal.

then.description: What the tag stands for when `if` holds.

else.description: What it stands for otherwise; without it the tag contributes nothing.
